runs.text: For the school page, is it better to export
When another program has to read the datum, a form it already knows is better. JSON is that for almost all of them.

justification.text: The page already knows how to read JSON, and there is no need to invent or explain rules for the semicolon.
It is shorter, but the page cannot read it: you would have to explain the rules to it.
It does: only one of the two is understood by the page without extra work.
